Together with Brooklyn Defender Services and the Legal Aid Society, we're requesting 11.06 million dollars for each organization, double our current budget, to ensure we have the resources proportional to the mass detention and deportation campaign we're fighting against. A deportation campaign that has particularly targeted immigrant New Yorkers. Since January, we have witnessed a staggering increase in detentions. Our recent clients include long-term green card holders detained at JFK after returning from visiting family abroad, undocumented parents and spouses of U.S. citizens swept up in home raids and on their way to work, and asylum seekers detained at ICE check-ins in front of their children, while doing exactly what our government asked them to do. Last week, ICE announced the imminent reopening of Delaney Hall, a detention facility in Newark with 1,000 beds. We urge the Council to act now to ensure we have the resources to fight back. 97 percent of detained immigrants without legal representation are unsuccessful in challenging their deportation.
